prompts.text: # Build: per-app override is the default (apps stop sharing nav/menus with AXF) Priority: urgent, top of the queue (Brett). ## Problem Right now, changing the navigation menu in the Dev Console also changes it in AmberX. Every app shares one nav, File menu, toolbars and so on. ## Wanted 1. In each app's **Settings > Appearance / Assets** (application settings), add a sync mode with two options: **Override AXF** (the **default**) and **Sync with AXF** (opt-in). 2. On the Override default, **only theme and colors sync** with AXF. Everything else is the app's own: navigation menu, File menu and …
